name: W Doha Hotel & Residences
positioning: A West Bay hotel and residences (officially W Doha) with the largest Sisley Spa worldwide, a skyline-view pool, playful statement suites and serviced residences with full kitchens
best_for: Spa-focused city stays in West Bay
Longer stays or families who want a residence with a kitchen and hotel services

facts.text: The hotel offers easy access to the Corniche, Katara Cultural Village and the beach.
Sisley Spa treatments combine plant-based science with luxurious techniques.
Market by Jean-Georges, inspired by traditional souks, mixes international cuisine with local Arabian flavors.
Wahm bar has international DJs, shisha and cocktails, indoors or outside by the pool.
The WOW Suite has floor-to-ceiling windows with ocean views.
The gym looks out over Doha's skyline.
The hotel apartments are designed for longer stays or family getaways.
The Residences have fully integrated kitchens, laundry facilities and a separate entrance and reception.

highlights.text: The spa is described as the largest Sisley Spa worldwide.
The Extreme WOW Suite has a hanging swing chair, an aquarium of exotic fish and a hexagonal bathtub with an Aquavision TV.
W Doha is in the heart of West Bay.
The pool has panoramic views of Doha's skyline.

considerations.text: Beach time is at Doha Beach Sands, minutes from the hotel, where guests have access.
WhataHotel notes a high-energy atmosphere throughout the common areas.
